title: KestrelCare Terms: Trip Days beyond the Limit
content:
**Clause.** When a covered breakdown keeps the holder away longer than the trip day limit of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan, the days beyond the cap are paid as follows: where the trip days exceed the cap and the repair is on the engine or the transmission, the amount is the capped days at the daily trip allowance plus each day beyond the cap at the overflow-day share of 50 percent of that allowance; where the trip days exceed the cap and the first case does not apply, the amount is the capped days at the daily trip allowance plus each day beyond the cap at the overflow meals amount of 35.00 USD per day, lodging no longer being paid; otherwise the amount is the trip days at the daily trip allowance. The days booked on the reimbursement are the capped days plus the days beyond the cap where those days are paid.

The daily trip allowance is the per-day amount the trip days are paid at; the vehicle system is the one on the plan's most recent approved claim decision entry.

| Trip days against the cap | Repair | Amount for the trip days | Days booked |
|---|---|---|---|
| above the cap | engine or transmission | capped days at the allowance, plus each extra day at 50 percent of the allowance | all trip days |
| above the cap | any other system | capped days at the allowance, plus 35.00 for each extra day | all trip days |
| at or below the cap | any | trip days at the allowance | the trip days |

*Hypothetical:* allowance 100.00, cap 3, trip days 5. On a transmission repair: 300.00 plus 2 days at 50.00, giving 400.00, 5 days booked. On an air conditioning repair: 300.00 plus 2 days at 35.00, giving 370.00, 5 days booked.
